The model can only swap faces if there is a corresponding alignments.json file within that same folder. This file is created by the extraction process, but it points to the frames in the aligned folder.

That is to say, you can't convert without an alignments.json, and alignment.json needs the frames in the aligned folder. If the frames in the alignments folder don't match the data values in alignments.json, either you will get messed up faces, or frame skipping.

So unless your script can create an alignments.json compatible with fakeapp, the best way to solve it is to not crop the image at all. Leave them at original resolution, but still check for bad frames.

So, an ideal script would not modify any frames. It would not create any new information, it would just get rid of blurry images, rotated images, cut off faces, and things that are clearly not faces, but were detected as such during extraction.

If you mess with the images, it is very, very likely that they will become unconvertible as alignments.json will not recognize them.

In terms of training, this tool might work just fine, since the training process does not require alignments.json. But after you are done training you still need to extract the faces from the video using fakeapp, and comb through all those frames. You can't modify extracted frames, nor add more frames, only delete them, as alignments.json will not recognize them if they are different, but it will skip them if it can't find them.
